audit.whatIsWrong: Level-2 phase text claimed 'Three turrets' at level 2.
audit.why: Heimerdinger has two H-28G charges at level 2; the third banks later. Aatrox's The Darkin Blade is 14/12/10/8/6s, so a rank-1 miss is a long window.
audit.corrected: Two turrets make your half of lane a no-entry zone. Trade when The Darkin Blade is down — it is 14s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level-6 text was generic, and the content-layer chart gave Aatrox the first-item and 2-item stages despite a 53.87% Heimerdinger win rate.
audit.why: UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70 and empowers the next spell; World Ender is 120/100/80 and is Aatrox's real level-6 window. After Liandry's plus anti-heal the nest out-damages Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing.
audit.corrected: Level 6 to Aatrox (World Ender + Infernal Chains on a dashless yordle); first item and 2+ items to Heimerdinger.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-3X' in five places; the turret beam was described as slowing; Infernal Chains was called a tether/yank.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's E is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat, 970 range) — it stuns on a direct hit and slows around it. The H-28G turret's secondary attack is a pass-through beam with no slow in Riot's text. Riot's Infernal Chains text says targets are dragged back to the centre if they do not leave the impact area.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade stuns on the direct hit — hold it for his Q3 knockup swing, not for poke. Infernal Chains drags you back to its centre off your own nest, so stay behind the buildings.

audit.why: Grievous Wounds is already listed early, which the missing-interaction file flags as the decider against Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash and World Ender healing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing warned that Aatrox's combo opens on an auto-attack reset.
audit.why: Deathbringer Stance is an auto-attack reset — the wind-up, not the ability cast, is the tell to step back.
audit.corrected: React to his auto wind-up rather than his Q cast when deciding to back out of turret range.

edits.before: Level 1 is the dangerous one — I have a single turret and no stun, so I concede the contact window and just bank Q charges instead of feeding him a free sweetspot Q. By 2-3 my second turret and its electron beam turn the wall in front of me into a tax zone: every time Aatrox steps up to land the Q edge he eats stacked turret fire plus the beam slow, and his heal-on-hit passive can't outpace two turrets at once. Don't fan rockets into his auto range chasing him — last-hit off the turrets and never let his W (Infernal Chains) catch you forward of my own nest.
edits.after: Level 1 is the dangerous one — I have a single turret and no stun, so I concede the contact window and just bank Q charges instead of feeding him a free sweetspot Q. By 2-3 my second turret and its pass-through beam turn the wall in front of me into a tax zone: every time Aatrox steps up to land the Q edge he eats stacked turret fire from both at once, and Deathbringer Stance can't outpace two turrets. Don't fan rockets into his auto range chasing him — last-hit off the turrets and never let his W (Infernal Chains) drag you back off my own nest.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are mine: three turret charges plus the CH-3X center-stun mean any Q1-Q2-Q3 all-in he tries gets him stunned and melted before his sustain catches up. Bait the trade — let him commit the first Q, drop the grenade so the center stun lands, and let the beams do the work. Level 6 is where I respect him: his R combat stats let him drain through the nest and his W (Infernal Chains) tethers and yanks me off my buildings, and I have no dash to answer it, so I hold the grenade for his all-in rather than poking it out early.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are mine: three turret charges plus the CH-2 grenade's direct-hit stun mean any Q1-Q2-Q3 all-in he tries gets him stunned and melted before his sustain catches up. Bait the trade — let him commit the first Q, drop the grenade so the direct hit stuns, and let the beams do the work. Level 6 is where I respect him: World Ender lets him drain through the nest and his W (Infernal Chains) drags me back off my buildings, and I have no dash to answer it, so I hold the grenade for his all-in rather than poking it early.

edits.before: Once we both have items the lane balances on a knife's edge — my super-turret siege and Rylai-slow still own the wave and the tower, but a fed Aatrox with R up and a drain mythic can lifesteal through three buildings and run me down the moment the grenade is on cooldown. I want to cash my lane lead into the tower before his teamfight reset matters; I'm a fantastic sieger but a terrible runner, so never get caught sidelaning without my nest set up. Save the center-stun for his engage, not his poke.
